name: 7SABER
verdict: Private Uzbek sportswear brand, founded by Ross Connon and Oraz Abdurazakov with backing from Dubai-based Berkeley Square Investments. Nothing found.
note: Kit supplier to the Uzbekistan national team since August 2025, replacing Jako; made the team's 2026 World Cup kit (UFA announcement, August 2025; Footy Headlines, 2026-05-26). No state body or fund found in the chain, and no court, regulator, UN-body or major-NGO human-rights finding against the company found (searched 1 Oct 2026).
